implications.text: Decision 0001 (shared links never expire) is reversed for links that choose a time.
A link can end two ways, revoked or expired; both must end it, and expiry is not behind the linkRevocation flag.
Links made before this change must keep working.

excluded.reason: The report counts entries; expiry adds no new action it needs.
